SELECT f.id AS followId, u.id AS userId, u.username, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.realname, ''), u.username) AS displayName, u.avatar, u.sign, f.created_at AS followedAt FROM ts_user_follow f INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.followed_user_id WHERE f.follower_user_id = #{query.userId} AND f.status = 1 AND u.status = 1 AND u.del_flag = 0
AND ( u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR u.realname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC
